title: Infinite Cushions
description: Lets you dye cushions in any colour, just like leather armour!
body:
![infinite_cushions_banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c626f6ffaecc009ce35b4115bafd3915f5c706fd_0.webp) This data pack tries to make the new cushions even better by allowing you to dye them in any colour! > ![Note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mqxx/GitHub-Markdown/main/blockquotes/badge/dark-theme/note.svg)
> Make sure to install it on the latest 26.3 snapshot either as a data pack and resource pack or as a Fabric mod. There might be bugs, this data pack is still in early development.
## Dyeing Cushions After you've got a white cushion, you can dye it using a crafting table. And, just like with leather armour, you will now be able to mix multiple dyes to craft cushions with unique colours. ![crafting_dyed_cushion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18b0e11314ecee4bd594934a3b5711f2e9da2f7e.png) Later on, if you want to remove the dyes from a cushion, simply right click with it on top of a Water Cauldron.
